A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right corner of the game-text box, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 18 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:EJP-D-dengarwithblastercarbine-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The wording differs from the 2013 slip: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (may target a character, creature or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 &gt; Defense value; may be fired twice per battle).”. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the game-text box.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
